rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the activity of going underwater and exploring or interacting with the underwater environment.

example.english: We’re going diving in the Philippines next month.
example.traditional: 我哋下個月去菲律賓潛水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 fei1 leot6 ban1 cim4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for the sport in which athletes jump from a board or platform and perform acrobatics before entering the water.

example.english: They entered a diving competition and then jumped from the ten-metre platform into the water.
example.traditional: 佢哋參加跳水比賽，仲由十米高台跳落水。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 caam1 gaa1 tiu3 seoi2 bei2 coi3 zung6 jau4 sap6 mai5 gou1 toi4 tiu3 lok6 seoi2
